en.name: Metastatic malignant neoplasm
en.shortDescription: Metastatic malignant neoplasm — cancer that has spread to distant sites; one of the APACHE IV chronic health conditions.
en.longDescription: ## Definition & Clinical Context A metastatic malignant neoplasm is a cancer that has spread (metastasised) from its primary site to distant organs. In intensive care, metastatic disease is a major prognostic comorbidity and informs goals-of-care discussions. Metastatic cancer is one of the chronic health items in the APACHE IV severity model. ## How the Data Is Stored Since OMOP vocabulary release v5.0 29-AUG-26, the OHDSI oncology model no longer records metastatic disease as a SNOMED condition: *432851 / 128462008 — Metastatic malignant neoplasm* and its descendants are non-standard. A source diagnosis such as "metastatic adenocarcinoma" or ICD-10 C78.7 "Secondary malignant neoplasm of liver" is split into: - the **primary tumour**, in CONDITION_OCCURRENCE (SNOMED); - the **metastasis**, in MEASUREMENT, coded with a Cancer Modifier concept (e.g. *Metastasis to liver*) and `value_as_concept_id` = *9191 — Positive*. The MEASUREMENT domain is the OMOP oncology convention for cancer modifiers (metastasis, stage, nodes, grade): they describe a tumour rather than being a disease on their own. Each modifier is linked to the tumour's CONDITION_OCCURRENCE record through two MEASUREMENT columns: `meas_event_field_concept_id` = *1147127 — condition_occurrence.condition_occurrence_id* (which table and field) and `measurement_event_id` = the tumour's `condition_occurrence_id` (which row) [1]. The OMOP CDM 5.4 EPISODE and EPISODE_EVENT tables can additionally attach modifiers to a disease episode. ## Scope The set is anchored on the Cancer Modifier concept *36769180 / OMOP4998856 — Metastasis* with all descendants: site-specific metastases (*Metastasis to liver*, *bone*, *brain*, *lung*, *pleura*…), *Generalized metastases*, *Malignant pleural effusion*, *Malignant ascites* and *Distant lymph nodes*. *36769664 / OMOP4999341 — Circulating tumor cells* is excluded. Tumour cells detected only in blood or bone marrow, without clinical or radiological evidence of metastasis, do not make a case metastatic: TNM records isolated tumour cells as a suffix to M0, "(i+)" [2]. For breast cancer, the AJCC 8th edition defines cM0(i+) as tumour cells or deposits no larger than 0.2 mm detected in circulating blood, bone marrow or other non-regional nodal tissue, in a patient without symptoms or signs of metastases [3]. ## Mapping Notes - Count a patient as having metastatic disease only when the measurement's value is **Positive** (`value_as_concept_id = 9191`): Cancer Modifier records can also state the absence of metastasis (value Negative). - **Regional** lymph node involvement is not distant metastasis and is not in this set: ICD-10 C77.x maps to the Cancer Modifier concept *Lymph nodes* (class Nodes), outside the *Metastasis* hierarchy. *Distant lymph nodes* (M1) is included. - Data converted with an earlier vocabulary release still holds the SNOMED condition 432851 and its descendants; it must be re-processed with the current vocabulary to be captured by this set. - A localised (non-metastatic) primary cancer is conceptually distinct and does not, by itself, map here. - Haematologic malignancies (leukemia, lymphoma, myeloma) have their own sets and are not "metastatic solid tumours". ## References [1] OHDSI Oncology Working Group. Conventions — Condition Modifiers (cancer modifiers stored as measurements, linked to the condition through meas_event_field_concept_id and measurement_event_id). Work in progress. Available: https://ohdsi.github.io/OncologyWG/conventions.html [2] Boeker M, França F, Bronsert P, et al. TNM-O: ontology support for staging of malignant tumours. *J Biomed Semantics*. 2016;7:64 (Table 1, suffix "(i+)" to pN0 or pM0). doi:10.1186/s13326-016-0106-9. Available: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5109740/ [3] NCI Thesaurus. Breast Cancer cM0(i+) TNM Finding v8 (code C139394), definition from the AJCC Cancer Staging Manual, 8th edition. Available: https://evsexplore.semantics.cancer.gov/evsexplore/concept/ncit/C139394

versions.author: Boris Delange
versions.message:
Redesigned for OMOP vocabulary v5.0 29-AUG-26 (issue #39).

**Why:** the OHDSI oncology remodelling made the SNOMED anchor *432851 Metastatic malignant neoplasm* and all its descendants non-standard. A metastatic diagnosis is now split into the primary tumour (Condition) and a Cancer Modifier metastasis record (Measurement, value Positive). Resolved as before, the set held no standard concept.

**Changes:**

- Anchor: 432851 Metastatic malignant neoplasm (SNOMED, Condition) → 36769180 Metastasis (Cancer Modifier, Measurement), with descendants.
- 88 → 530 concepts: the 88 SNOMED conditions (now non-standard) are replaced by the Cancer Modifier metastasis hierarchy, minus *Circulating tumor cells* (36769664), excluded: isolated tumour cells in blood or bone marrow are M0(i+), not distant metastasis.
- Cancer Modifier added to the allowed vocabularies (config.json).
- Description rewritten: count only measurements with value Positive (9191); regional lymph nodes (Cancer Modifier class Nodes, e.g. ICD-10 C77) are not distant metastasis and stay out; explains how the metastasis record is linked to the tumour's condition (meas_event_field_concept_id 1147127 + measurement_event_id); references added.
